description: An introductory AI course site for core concepts, search, reasoning, and ethical use of intelligent systems, built from the TQF3-first workflow in this repo.

badges.name: Starter
badges.req: Begin the course and collect the first XP.

badges.name: Explorer
badges.req: Reach 120 XP and complete at least 1 module.

badges.name: Intro to AI Master
badges.req: Reach 600 XP and maintain at least 80% mission accuracy.

badges.name: CLO1 Understand AI Language
badges.req: Collect quick-check evidence in AI Foundations.

badges.name: CLO2 Apply Search Strategist
badges.req: Collect SBRA evidence in Search and Problem Solving.

badges.name: CLO3 Analyze Reasoning Analyst
badges.req: Collect reasoning-task evidence in Knowledge and Reasoning.

badges.name: CLO4 Evaluate Ethical Evaluator
badges.req: Collect reflection-task evidence in Intelligent Systems and Ethics.

modules.title: AI Foundations
modules.summary: Start with core AI ideas, scope, domains, and the language used across the field.

modules.title: Search and Problem Solving
modules.summary: Use state spaces, search strategies, and heuristics to reason about AI problem solving.

modules.title: Knowledge and Reasoning
modules.summary: Connect representation, logic, and inference to structured AI reasoning tasks.

modules.title: Intelligent Systems and Ethics
modules.summary: Relate AI methods to real systems, limitations, and ethical decision making.

clos.label: Explain core AI concepts, terminology, and problem domains.
Apply search, reasoning, and representation ideas to structured AI tasks.
Analyze AI methods, model behavior, and suitable solution strategies.
Evaluate AI use cases, limitations, and ethical implications in practical settings.
